title: Happy Ours Too at Camp Creek | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
h1: Happy Ours Too at Camp Creek
meta_description: Happy Ours Too at Camp Creek is a 3.00 bedroom, 2.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Happy Ours Too — 3‑Bedroom Camp Creek Home with Pool & 30A AdventuresHappy Ours Too at Camp Creek is a 3-bedroom, 2-bath home located in The Cottages of Camp Creek in Seacrest Beach. This well-situated retreat comfortably sleeps up to six and features a large covered deck overlooking the community pool, making it an easy spot for morning coffee or evening downtime after a beach day. With dedicated community beach access and close proximity to both Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, guests can enjoy a mix of laid-back beach days and nearby dining, shopping, and scenic walks along 30A.Your SpaceInside, the home welcomes you with a bright, open-living layout designed for spending quality time together. The living area connects seamlessly to a fully equipped kitchen complete with a coffee maker, toaster, microwave, and a refrigerator with an ice maker. The dining table seats four and sits next to a breakfast bar with three stools, offering flexible seating for meals, games, or planning the day ahead. A washer and dryer are also available, adding convenience for longer stays or active days outdoors.Sleeping ArrangementsPrimary Bedroom: King bed, TV, private bathroom with combo shower/tubGuest Bedroom 1: Queen bed, TV, shared hallway bathroomGuest Bedroom 2: Twin-over-twin bedCommunity and Outdoor AmenitiesAs part of The Cottages at Camp Creek, you will enjoy the 86 foot community pool, perfect for cooling off and socializing, a soothing hot tub to relax after an active day, and private deeded beach access just minutes from the Gulf’s white sands.Local Attractions & ExperiencesThe cottage is perfectly positioned to explore the best of 30A:* Seacrest Town Center and Watersound Towncenter for Publix, Ambrosia, Village Market, Nigels, and Sweet Henriettas.* Dining favorites like Amigos, Amicis, Idyll Proper, and Attycat's Arcade along 30Avenue.* Unique shopping and entertainment at Shades, George’s Alys Beach, Peddlers Pavilion, and Rosemary Downtown (including The Pearl and Sugar Shack).* Bike or stroll along scenic 30A pathways to experience coastal charm, boutique shops, and local eateries, all within reach from your cottage.Your stay at Happy Ours Too at Camp Creek comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!Other Things to Note:* Snowbird Friendly!* Sorry, no pets allowed.* Parking for 2 cars.A Benchmark initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
